text: Show those qualities then which are altogether in thy power, sincerity, gravity, endurance of labor, aversion to pleasure, contentment with thy portion and with few things, benevolence, frankness, no love of superfluity, freedom from trifling, magnanimity.
author: Marcus Aurelius
location: On campaign on the Danube frontier, e.g. Carnuntum or Sirmium (presumed)
